_comment: DRAFT PREPARED 20 Nov 2026 FROM THE FOUNDER'S CONFIRMED STATUS (Czech identified person). NOT the accountant's written answer and NOT loaded by the code: config/tax-policy.json stays unapproved until the accountant confirms each line in writing and the approval block is filled. Every decision text below is a proposal for the accountant to confirm, correct or replace.

seller.address: Školská 1736/12, Nové Město, 110 00 Praha 1, Czech Republic
seller._note: vatId = DIČ shown on the published legal pages; accountant confirms it and fills the registration date (vatEffectiveFrom).

decisions.T1_vatStatus: PROPOSED: Colleague AI s.r.o. is an identified person (identifikovaná osoba, § 6g–6l ZDPH), DIČ CZ29540852, from [date]. It does not charge Czech VAT on domestic supplies and is not a VAT payer; it files a VAT return only for periods with cross-border transactions and an EC Sales List (souhrnné hlášení) for reverse-charge services supplied to EU businesses.
decisions.T2_euBusinessWithVatId: PROPOSED: Place of supply is the customer's member state (§ 9(1) ZDPH / Art. 44 Directive 2006/112/EC); the customer accounts for VAT (reverse charge). Invoice without Czech VAT, with the note 'Daň odvede zákazník / Reverse charge - Art. 196 Directive 2006/112/EC' and both VAT IDs; reported in the EC Sales List. First-sale treatment: HOLD (manual handling) until the accountant confirms, or SELL once confirmed.
decisions.T3_domesticBusiness: PROPOSED: Supply by an identified person to a Czech business: no VAT charged; invoice (not a daňový doklad) with the note 'Neplátce DPH - identifikovaná osoba'. SELL.
decisions.T4_nonEuBusiness: PROPOSED: Place of supply outside the EU; outside the scope of Czech VAT; note 'Outside the scope of Czech VAT (§ 9(1) ZDPH)'. First-sale treatment: HOLD until confirmed.
decisions.T5_businessStatusAndNoVatId: PROPOSED: An EU buyer without a VAT ID that declares it buys in the course of business: treated as a taxable person only with other evidence; default HOLD for manual handling (the accountant decides what evidence suffices).
decisions.T6_licenceClassification: PROPOSED: A perpetual software licence delivered as a download is an electronically supplied service (Art. 7 Implementing Regulation (EU) 282/2011); B2B general place-of-supply rule applies.
decisions.T7_taxDocumentRequirements: PROPOSED: Document per § 29 ZDPH where a daňový doklad is required (reverse-charge supplies to EU businesses); date of taxable supply (DUZP) = the day the service is supplied, i.e. the day of payment for a licence delivered on payment (§ 21 ZDPH); English and USD acceptable with the CZK base recorded in the VAT records; Stripe's number series acceptable (Q1-Q4 of the route assessment).
decisions.T8_currencyConversion: PROPOSED: USD amounts converted to CZK at the ČNB rate valid on the date of taxable supply (§ 4(8) ZDPH) for the VAT return and EC Sales List; accounting conversion per the accounting policy (daily ČNB rate or fixed rate). The conversion is an accounting step from the payout reconciliation; printed on the invoice only if the accountant requires it.
decisions.T9_revenueRecognition: PROPOSED: Revenue recognised on delivery of the perpetual licence (download available), i.e. at payment; the accountant confirms.
decisions.T10_partnerCommissions: PROPOSED: Partner commissions are purchased services; a partner established in the EU invoices with reverse charge to the identified person, who self-assesses; the accountant confirms the regime per partner.
decisions.T11_servicesFromAbroad: PROPOSED: Services received from abroad (Microsoft Copilot Studio consumption, Vercel, Stripe fees, Upstash, Resend, Anthropic) are reverse-charged by the identified person (§ 108 ZDPH): Czech VAT self-assessed in the VAT return for the month of receipt, due by the 25th of the following month, with no input VAT deduction. The 25 November return covers October.
decisions.T12_bankTransferProforma: PROPOSED: Bank-transfer orders receive a proforma (not a tax document) from the invoicing route; the invoice/tax document is issued on receipt of payment (DUZP = payment date). Bank transfer stays off for the first sale (CAI_PAYMENT_METHODS=card).
decisions.T13_invoiceRoute: PROPOSED: Stripe post-payment invoice ('stripe') for the first sale, subject to Q1-Q4 in docs/commerce/invoicing-route-assessment.md; Czech tool only if the accountant requires a Czech number series, a labelled DUZP, CZK on the document or a proforma.
decisions.T14_microsoftConsumption: PROPOSED: Microsoft bills Copilot Studio consumption to the customer directly; nothing to invoice or re-charge by Colleague AI.
